hook.narration: When doctors stitch you shut, some thread is never coming out.

visual.v3: soft skin-hill landscape (bright clinic-golden, lum/sat in bible band); curved needle draws a bead-chain seam across the hill; the seam GLOWS once and stays; title THE STITCHES DOCTORS NEVER REMOVE on frame 0 (loop target)

fact_sources: absorbable sutures are placed and left to degrade in tissue — Ethicon Wound Closure Manual (2005), 'Absorbable Materials' chapter

scenes.narration: Nobody removes it. Nobody pulls anything.

visual.v3: surgeon-bean walks AWAY from the seam, hands empty; no tweezers, no pull; the seam stays shut behind him

fact_sources: no removal visit for absorbable skin closures — Ethicon WCM; standard post-op instructions

scenes.narration: The thread is engineered to vanish inside you.

visual.v3: macro zoom to the bead-chain; each link has a tiny clock face; the whole thread fades from tail-end in a loop

fact_sources: synthetic absorbable sutures are designed to lose strength and mass over defined timescales — Chu & von Fraunhofer, Wound Closure Biomaterials (1997)

scenes.narration: It's a polymer chain: thousands of links, sewn into your skin.

visual.v3: the chain re-renders as glowing polymer links (beads on a string) sewn INTO the hill's cross-section (x-ray view like #0006); count ticks up '1,000+ links'

fact_sources: polyglycolide / polyglactin 910 are polyester chains of repeating units — Ethicon WCM materials table

visual.v3: a single water-bean droplet slides into frame from the bright sky, glinting; freeze-frame flash (4f) on the droplet's edge

fact_sources: hydrolysis = water-driven bond cleavage — chemistry of polyester degradation (Ethicon WCM)

scenes.narration: Each water molecule slips in and snaps one link.

visual.v3: droplet wedges between two beads; the link ping-pops apart (kick frame); second droplet repeats on the next link; chain gets shorter

fact_sources: water hydrolyzes ester bonds in the polymer backbone, fragmenting the chain — Chu & von Fraunhofer (1997)

scenes.narration: Week one, the thread still holds your wound shut.

visual.v3: the hill-seam stays tightly zipped; a small 'WEEK 1' chalk tick; camera creeps closer on the seam (hold-creep law)

fact_sources: polyglactin 910 retains ~65% tensile strength at 1 week — Ethicon VICRYL specification sheet

scenes.narration: By week two, it's lost half its strength.

visual.v3: 'WEEK 2' tick; the chain's beads dim one-by-one (half go dark); a strength-bar over the seam drains to 50%; thump

fact_sources: polyglactin 910 retains ~50% tensile strength at 2 weeks — Ethicon VICRYL specification sheet

scenes.narration: Your cleanup cells swallow the fragments whole.

visual.v3: macrophage-beans (round, purposeful) roll in, each absorbs a bead fragment and glows slightly; riser on the swallow

fact_sources: macrophages phagocytose suture fragments in the foreign-body response — Ethicon WCM 'Tissue Response' section

visual.v3: VISUAL-ONLY HOLD (~1.2s): macro of the swallowed fragments inside the translucent tissue — each dimmed bead pulses faintly inside a macrophage-bean, one last pulse, then stillness; camera creeps closer through the whole hold (creep law)

scenes.note: L-097 headroom beat (lint advice): buys VO-overrun slack between the swallow and the no-exit reveal

scenes.narration: Inside your body, there is no other exit.

visual.v3: wide shot: the hill seam now INSIDE a translucent body cross-section; no door, no edge-exit; the seam only fades

fact_sources: internal sutures cannot be removed without re-operation; absorbable materials are standard for deep closure — Ethicon WCM

scenes.narration: So the thread is tuned: fast for skin, slow for muscle.

visual.v3: two threads side by side: a slim fast chain (skin) dissolving quickly; a thick slow chain (muscle/fascia) holding months; blip pair on the two labels

fact_sources: material selection matches absorption to tissue healing: fast-absorbing for skin/mucosa, PDS-class for fascia lasting months — Ethicon WCM materials selection guide

scenes.narration: Some stitches outlive you — the permanent kind never dissolves.

visual.v3: a steel-bright thread that never dims, glinting in the clinic-golden light; a small 'PERMANENT' plate; the dissolving chains fade behind it

fact_sources: non-absorbable materials (polypropylene, silk) are effectively permanent — Ethicon WCM 'Nonabsorbable Materials'

scenes.narration: The best stitches are the ones your body erases.

visual.v3: the whole hill-seam dissolves to nothing; only clean smooth skin remains in full daylight (day LOOK); end frame mirrors the hook seam-pull (loop target); banner: GONE WITHOUT A TRACE

fact_sources: optimal absorbable closure leaves minimal residue at end of absorption period — Chu & von Fraunhofer (1997)

sfx.note: seam gone - clean skin lands (s11 closer)
